          learning WTO distance learning The WTO offers on this page a number of interactive 
          training modules on WTO subjects. Each module is built on course material 
          developed by WTO experts and includes a number of interactive tests to 
          assess the user’s progress. Please feel free to send us your feedback on these training modules back to top Training modules Each of the training modules below offers users 
          the possibility of taking the course over a number of sessions. Follow 
          the simple registration procedure to begin a course. Information on your 
          progress will be stored in your browser using a cookie. (Note — your browser 
          must be set through the options menu to accept cookies. You may still 
          take the course without the cookie but the program will not store details 
          on your progress through the course). Interactive courses: General Agreement on Trade in Services (GATS) Agreement on Sanitary and Phytosanitary Measures (SPS) SPS Handbook: How to apply the transparency provisions of the SPS Agreement WTO dispute settlement system Handbook on Accession to the WTO back to top Multimedia presentations Sanitary and Phytosanitary Measures — provides background on certain aspects of the SPS Agreement Technical Barriers to Trade: Fifth Special Meeting on Procedures for Information Exchange — audio clips — 7-8 November 2007 The WTO: Economic Underpinnings — provides background on trade theory The WTO: Legal Underpinnings — learn about the basic principles of the Multilateral Trading System back to top Briefings Trade Finance: The Grease in the Wheels of Trade Conducting a WTO Trade Facilitation Needs Assessment WTO Trade Facilitation The WTO Coherence Mandate back to top Other work in the WTO
